headline: Demand for housing remains strong despite challenges
content: Although there still seem to be new projects underway, northern demand could decrease this year according to figures from Urbania. Regions such as La Libertad reached levels of 8093 units in 2016 but may not reach half these numbers within the first six months of this year. Amazonas comes closest at just 17 units away from reaching 50 percent of last year’s figure while Loreto has achieved 33054 units during the initial semester.

headline: Towards the South
content: Regions like Arequipa, Ica, Cuzco, and Tacna have shown significant interest in property searches. Only Puno advances ahead of places like Ayacuchu and Madre de Dios which moved four positions down. When it comes to demanded quantities, fewer figures were observed compared to those recorded throughout 2016. Areas nearing their previous annual totals include Cuzco, currently standing at 1264 out of 3296.

headline: Land Prices Rise Across Districts
content: Despite a moderate start to the year, the real estate market shows signs of renewed activity evidenced by rising land prices sought by construction companies for building residential, office, or commercial structures. According to Urbania, between January and June of this year, average land costs increased by seven percent across twenty districts in Metropolitan Lima showing high demand.

headline: Basura y Desidia
content: No solo Lima tiene el grave problema del tratamiento de los residuos sólidos (basura), sino el problema se extiende a nivel nacional. Tanto es así que el propio Ministerio del Ambiente advierte que hay 1200 botaderos ilegales en todo el país, que son usados por los propios municipios o empresas privadas que se dedican a la limpieza. Claro, no contamos aquellos puntos donde los propios vecinos o carretilleros arrojan los desperdicios, como ríos y quebradas.
